name: Slit-Scan Time Smear
desc: A slit-scan / rolling-shutter time-smear where every column samples a drifting colourful noise-stripe field at a different moment, pulling motion into liquid diagonal taffy ribbons — spectral chromatic smear, VHS chroma-split warp, infrared thermal, soft aurora curtains, or high-contrast mono film.

span.doc: time-smear amount (per-column time offset; higher = longer liquid diagonal smear)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg; lower leaves smear trails)
